meta.name: fullenrich-network-activation
meta.description: Use when the user says "activate co-founder network with FullEnrich", "enrich LinkedIn connections export", "qualify my LinkedIn connections CSV", "turn Connections.csv into a lead list", "FullEnrich network activation", or any variant indicating they want to convert a LinkedIn personal-network CSV export into ICP-qualified leads with FullEnrich-verified emails and phones. Reads the LinkedIn Data Export Connections.csv, applies an ICP filter, then enriches missing contact info via FullEnrich v2 with webhook callback delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LinkedIn人脉导出转为合格线索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有LinkedIn人脉CSV，想自动筛选并补全联系方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn LinkedIn connections export into qualified leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a LinkedIn connections CSV and want to auto-filter and enrich contact info

howto.what: 读取你提供的 LinkedIn Connections.csv 文件，按 ICP 规则筛选出符合目标客户画像的联系人，然后通过 FullEnrich 补充缺失的邮箱和电话，最后输出一份排名后的潜客列表。
howto.when: 当你说“激活我的 LinkedIn 网络”、“用 FullEnrich 丰富 LinkedIn 连接”或要求将 Connections.csv 转化为潜客列表时触发。

say.text: 激活我的 LinkedIn 网络，用 FullEnrich 补充联系信息。
say.note: Claude 会先以 dry-run 模式估算信用点消耗。

say.text: 把 Connections.csv 变成合格的潜客列表。
say.note: 需要你提供 CSV 文件路径。

say.text: 用 FullEnrich 丰富我的 LinkedIn 导出。
say.note: Claude 会询问确认后才实际花信用点。

howto.what_en: Reads your LinkedIn Connections.csv, applies an ICP filter to score and qualify contacts, then enriches missing emails and phones via FullEnrich, outputting a ranked lead list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'activate co-founder network with FullEnrich', 'enrich LinkedIn connections export', or ask to turn Connections.csv into a lead list.

say_en.text: Activate my LinkedIn network with FullEnrich and enrich contact info.
say_en.note: Claude will run a dry-run first to estimate credits.

say_en.text: Turn my Connections.csv into a qualified lead list.
say_en.note: You need to provide the CSV file path.

say_en.text: Enrich my LinkedIn export with FullEnrich.
say_en.note: Claude asks for confirmation before spending credits.
